result_text:
The landscape contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. I compiled the `reports` module and ran its tests offline; both passed with no errors printed. I did not regenerate a landscape report to inspect the HTML.

Two changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on the sorted contributor stream, so every contributor is written to the table. Also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged. This class backs the All, Recent, bots and teams pages.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors`, so the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` stays in `LandscapeConfiguration` and is now unused by these two paths. I left `ContributorsReportGenerator.java` alone: its hard-coded 500 cap is in the per-repository contributors report, not the landscape report.

I did not commit.
